cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial maintenance screen renders with header, key fields and the entry prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator has just started the Disclosure Group Maintenance transaction (ORDG); no data has been entered yet.
cases.steps:
1. Sign on and select Disclosure Group Maintenance (transaction ORDG) from the main menu.
2. Observe the screen as first displayed.
cases.expected: The maintenance screen (MDGRPA) opens with the header line showing Tran `ORDG`, Pgm `OCDGRP`, the system title `ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM`, and the current date and time; the captions `Acct Group:`, `Type Code :`, `Cat Code  :` and `Int Rate :` are shown with empty input fields; the cursor rests on the Account Group field; the message line shows `Enter group, type, category and press ENTER.`
cases.remark: UI §2.1 MDGRPA / SDD-MAP-020 · 0000-MAIN (EIBCALEN=0) → 1000-SEND-INITIAL · 8000-POPULATE-HEADER · WS-M-PROMPT · state CA-WORK-AREA(1:1)='K'

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Stored interest rate is shown right-justified with two decimals when a group is loaded
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Gold / type 01 / category 0001 group exists on file with interest rate 19.99.
cases.steps:
1. On the maintenance screen enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `01`, Category `0001`.
2. Press ENTER to look up the group.
3. Observe the Interest Rate field.
cases.data: Acct Group=GOLD, Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001 (on file, rate 19.99)
cases.expected: The Interest Rate field displays `  19.99` (right-justified, two decimal places); the message line shows `Group found. Change rate, PF5 to update.`
cases.remark: 2100-LOOKUP → 3000-READ-DGRP (REC-FOUND) · DG-INT-RATE → WS-RATE-ED (PIC ZZZ9.99) → DGRATEO · WS-M-FOUND

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Look up an existing disclosure group and open it for maintenance
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Gold / type 01 / category 0001 group exists on file with rate 19.99.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `01`, Category `0001`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Acct Group=GOLD, Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001
cases.expected: The group is found; its interest rate `  19.99` is shown; the message line shows `Group found. Change rate, PF5 to update.`; the cursor moves to the Interest Rate field so the operator can change it and save with PF5.
cases.remark: 2100-LOOKUP → 3000-READ-DGRP RESP(NORMAL) REC-FOUND · state → 'E' · WS-M-FOUND · DGRPFILE (disclosure group file)

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Look up a group that is not on file and start a new definition
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for Silver / type 01 / category 0001.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `SILVER`, Type Code `01`, Category `0001`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Acct Group=SILVER, Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001 (not on file)
cases.expected: The system reports the key is new: the Interest Rate field is blank and the message line shows `New group. Enter rate, PF5 to add.`; the cursor moves to the Interest Rate field for entry.
cases.remark: 2100-LOOKUP → 3000-READ-DGRP RESP(NOTFND) REC-NOT-FOUND · state → 'N' · WS-M-NEW

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Add a new disclosure group definition
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for Silver / type 01 / category 0001.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `SILVER`, Type Code `01`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (screen reports a new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate `9.99`.
3. Press PF5 to save.
cases.data: Acct Group=SILVER, Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001, Int Rate=9.99
cases.expected: A new record is created in the disclosure group file with rate 9.99; the message line shows `Disclosure group added.`; the group is now treated as existing so a further PF5 would update it.
cases.remark: PF5 → 2300-SAVE (state 'N') → 3600-ADD-DGRP EXEC CICS WRITE RESP(NORMAL) · WS-M-ADDED · state → 'E'

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Change the interest rate of an existing disclosure group
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Gold / type 01 / category 0001 group exists with rate 19.99.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `01`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (rate `  19.99` shown).
2. Change the Interest Rate to `20.50`.
3. Press PF5 to save.
cases.data: Acct Group=GOLD, Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001, new Int Rate=20.50
cases.expected: The record's interest rate is changed from 19.99 to 20.50; the message line shows `Disclosure group updated.`
cases.remark: PF5 → 2300-SAVE (state 'E') → 3500-UPDATE-DGRP READ UPDATE + REWRITE RESP(NORMAL) · WS-M-UPDATED

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Interest rate entry accepts a single decimal digit, surrounding spaces and whole numbers
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for Silver / type 02 / category 0007.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `SILVER`, Type Code `02`, Category `0007`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate as ` 8.5 ` (with surrounding spaces).
3. Press PF5 to save.
cases.data: Int Rate input=` 8.5 ` → stored 8.50 (a whole number `12` would store as 12.00)
cases.expected: Leading and trailing spaces are ignored and the single fraction digit is scaled, so the stored rate is 8.50; the message line shows `Disclosure group added.`
cases.remark: 6200-VALIDATE-RATE → 6300-PARSE-RATE: spaces skipped, WS-RE-FRAC-CNT=1 → *10; COMPUTE WS-RE-RESULT = int + frac/100

cases.name: A saved new group stores every key column plus the rate, with unused record space cleared
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for Silver / type 01 / category 0002.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `SILVER`, Type Code `01`, Category `0002`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate `10.00`; press PF5.
3. Inspect the stored record.
cases.data: Acct Group=SILVER, Type Code=01, Cat Code=0002, Int Rate=10.00
cases.expected: The stored record holds Account Group `SILVER`, Type Code `01`, Category `0002`, interest rate 10.00, and the trailing record filler is cleared to spaces (record length 50).
cases.remark: 3600-ADD-DGRP INITIALIZE DGRP-REC then MOVE key + DG-INT-RATE; FILLER X(28); LRECL 50 (RDGRP)

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Updating a group changes only the interest rate and preserves the key and other record data
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Standard / type 01 / category 0001 group exists with rate 24.99.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `STANDARD`, Type Code `01`, Category `0001`; press ENTER.
2. Change Interest Rate to `25.75`; press PF5.
3. Look the group up again.
cases.data: Acct Group=STANDARD, Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001, new Int Rate=25.75
cases.expected: Only the interest rate changes (24.99 → 25.75); the key (group `STANDARD`, type `01`, category `0001`) and the rest of the record are unchanged; the message line shows `Disclosure group updated.`
cases.remark: 3500-UPDATE-DGRP: READ UPDATE reads full record, only DG-INT-RATE replaced before REWRITE — key & FILLER preserved

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Re-saving straight after an add updates the same record instead of creating a duplicate
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for Silver / type 03 / category 0001.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `SILVER`, Type Code `03`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate `5.00`; press PF5 (group added).
3. Without changing the key, press PF5 again.
cases.data: Acct Group=SILVER, Type Code=03, Cat Code=0001, Int Rate=5.00
cases.expected: The first PF5 adds the group (`Disclosure group added.`); because the key is now marked as existing, the second PF5 updates the same record (`Disclosure group updated.`) rather than adding a duplicate — only one record exists.
cases.remark: 3600-ADD-DGRP sets state → 'E'; next PF5 → 2300-SAVE state 'E' → 3500-UPDATE-DGRP (idempotent, no duplicate WRITE)

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Saving an existing group that has since been removed re-creates it as an add
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Platinum / type 01 / category 0001 group exists with rate 14.99. *(needs the record to be removed externally — e.g. by a batch / IDCAMS delete — between the lookup and the save)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `PLATINUM`, Type Code `01`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (group found).
2. Have the record removed from the file externally.
3. Change Interest Rate to `13.50`; press PF5.
cases.data: Acct Group=PLATINUM, Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001, Int Rate=13.50
cases.expected: The update finds the record gone and falls back to an add, re-creating the group with rate 13.50; the message line shows `Disclosure group added.`
cases.remark: 3500-UPDATE-DGRP READ UPDATE RESP(NOTFND) → PERFORM 3600-ADD-DGRP · there is no in-app delete path (removal is external)

cases.name: PF4 clears entered values and returns to the initial key prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator has typed values into the key fields on the maintenance screen.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `01`, Category `0001` (do not press ENTER yet).
2. Press PF4.
cases.expected: The screen is cleared back to the initial state: all input fields are blank, the message line shows `Enter group, type, category and press ENTER.`, and the maintenance state returns to key-entry (a following PF5 would be rejected until ENTER is pressed).
cases.remark: PF4 → 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL · state → 'K' · WS-M-PROMPT

cases.name: Maintenance state is carried across the ENTER then PF5 steps
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Gold / type 03 / category 0001 group exists with rate 22.99.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `03`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (group found, state becomes existing).
2. Change Interest Rate to `21.00`; press PF5.
cases.data: Acct Group=GOLD, Type Code=03, Cat Code=0001, new Int Rate=21.00
cases.expected: Although the transaction ends and restarts between the two key presses, the existing-group state set by ENTER is retained (held in the conversation area), so PF5 correctly updates the record (`Disclosure group updated.`) rather than treating it as a fresh key.
cases.remark: pseudo-conversational: 9000-RETURN TRANSID('ORDG') COMMAREA; state in CA-WORK-AREA(1:1) survives the round-trip

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: PF3 cancels maintenance and returns to the main menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. Press PF3.
cases.expected: The maintenance transaction hands control to the main menu program (OCMENU), passing the shared conversation area; the main menu screen is displayed.
cases.remark: PF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(OCMENU) COMMAREA(ORION-COMMAREA) · CA-FROM-PROGRAM / CA-FROM-TRANID set

cases.name: Account group left blank is rejected on lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Leave the Account Group field blank; enter Type Code `01`, Category `0001`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Acct Group=(blank), Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001
cases.expected: The lookup is rejected; the message line shows `Account group id is required.` and the cursor returns to the Account Group field.
cases.remark: 6100-VALIDATE-KEY: DGGRPI = spaces / low-values → WS-M-GRP-REQ (same check re-runs on PF5 save). No EI/EF code — literal English message is the assertion.

cases.name: Type code left blank is rejected on lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`; leave the Type Code field blank; enter Category `0001`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Acct Group=GOLD, Type Code=(blank), Cat Code=0001
cases.expected: The lookup is rejected; the message line shows `Type code is required.`
cases.remark: 6100-VALIDATE-KEY: DGTYPEI = spaces / low-values → WS-M-TYPE-REQ. No EI/EF code — literal English message is the assertion.

cases.name: Non-numeric category code is rejected on lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `01`, Category `12A4` (contains a letter).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Acct Group=GOLD, Type Code=01, Cat Code=12A4 (non-numeric); a blank category behaves the same way
cases.expected: The lookup is rejected; the message line shows `Category code must be numeric.` (a blank category, which yields no digits, is rejected with the same message).
cases.remark: 6100-VALIDATE-KEY → 6000-PARSE-NUM: non-digit char or zero digits → WS-M-CAT-NUM. No EI/EF code.

cases.name: A non-numeric interest rate is rejected when saving
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for Silver / type 01 / category 0003.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `SILVER`, Type Code `01`, Category `0003`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate `12A` (contains a letter).
3. Press PF5.
cases.data: Int Rate=12A (invalid); a blank rate behaves the same way
cases.expected: The save is rejected; the message line shows `Interest rate is not a valid number.` and no record is written (a blank rate is rejected with the same message).
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE → 6200-VALIDATE-RATE → 6300-PARSE-RATE: non-digit / all-blank → WS-M-RATE-BAD. Rate is only validated on PF5, not on ENTER lookup.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: An unsupported function key is rejected with a message
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. Press an unsupported key (for example PF1).
cases.data: AID key = PF1 (unsupported)
cases.expected: The action is rejected; the message line shows `Invalid key pressed. Please try again.` and the screen stays on the maintenance map awaiting a valid key.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN OTHER → WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY (WMSG copybook) → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY. No EI/EF code.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Pressing PF5 to save before looking up a key is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is at the initial key-entry state (no ENTER pressed yet).
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `01`, Category `0001`.
2. Press PF5 without pressing ENTER first.
cases.data: Acct Group=GOLD, Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001; save attempted before lookup
cases.expected: The save is rejected because the key has not been looked up; the message line shows `Enter the key and press ENTER first.` and the cursor returns to the Account Group field.
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE guard: CA-WORK-AREA(1:1) not 'E' and not 'N' (still 'K') → WS-M-KEY-FIRST. No EI/EF code.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unrecoverable file error ends the transaction with a support message
cases.precondition: F-STD. *(needs the disclosure group file to be disabled / closed or to return an abnormal I/O condition on read)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `01`, Category `0001`.
2. Press ENTER while the file cannot be read normally.
cases.data: Disclosure group file unavailable (abnormal I/O response)
cases.expected: The program cannot continue and aborts the transaction, sending the full-screen text `OCDGRP: unrecoverable file error. Contact support.` and ending the transaction.
cases.remark: 3000-READ-DGRP EVALUATE WHEN OTHER → 9500-ABEND-RTN EXEC CICS SEND TEXT + RETURN · also reachable from 3500 READ UPDATE. No EI/EF code.

cases.mid: 排他・同時実行 (Exclusion / concurrent access)
cases.name: A save that collides with a concurrently created record reports a save error
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for Silver / type 02 / category 0001 at lookup time. *(needs the same key to be created concurrently by another task before this save writes it)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `SILVER`, Type Code `02`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Have another task create the same key.
3. Enter Interest Rate `7.25`; press PF5.
cases.data: Acct Group=SILVER, Type Code=02, Cat Code=0001, Int Rate=7.25 (duplicate on write)
cases.expected: The add fails because the key already exists; the message line shows `Error saving the disclosure group.` and no second record is created.
cases.remark: 3600-ADD-DGRP EXEC CICS WRITE RESP(DUPREC) → WS-M-SAVE-ERR · also a non-normal REWRITE in 3500 → same message. No EI/EF code.

cases.name: Pressing ENTER with no data entered is handled as an empty entry
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed with all fields empty.
cases.steps: 1. Without typing anything, press ENTER.
cases.data: No fields modified (empty transmit / map-fail)
cases.expected: The empty transmit is treated as blank input; the required-field check fires and the message line shows `Account group id is required.`, leaving the operator on the maintenance screen to try again.
cases.remark: 2050-RECEIVE RESP(MAPFAIL) → MOVE LOW-VALUES; 6100-VALIDATE-KEY → WS-M-GRP-REQ. No EI/EF code.

cases.name: Key fields accept their maximum lengths and category its maximum value
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for the maximum-length key below.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLDPLATIN` (10 characters), Type Code `03` (2 characters), Category `9999` (4 digits).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Acct Group=GOLDPLATIN (10), Type Code=03 (2), Cat Code=9999 (max)
cases.expected: All three key fields are accepted at their maximum size (group 10 characters, type 2 characters, category 4 digits = 9999); the key is looked up and reported as a new group (`New group. Enter rate, PF5 to add.`).
cases.remark: DGGRP X(10), DGTYPE X(2), DGCAT 9(4); 6000-PARSE-NUM accepts up to 4 digits

cases.name: Key fields accept a single character or digit
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for the single-character key below.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `A` (1 character), Type Code `1` (1 character), Category `5` (1 digit).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Acct Group=A, Type Code=1, Cat Code=5 → category value 0005
cases.expected: The single-character group and type and the single-digit category are accepted (category becomes 0005); the key is reported as a new group (`New group. Enter rate, PF5 to add.`).
cases.remark: group / type non-blank one char passes the required check; 6000-PARSE-NUM: 1 digit → value 5

cases.name: Category value zero is accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for the key below.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `09`, Category `0` (single zero).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Cat Code input=0 → value 0000
cases.expected: The category is accepted as value 0000 (one digit counts as numeric); the key is reported as a new group (`New group. Enter rate, PF5 to add.`).
cases.remark: 6000-PARSE-NUM: WS-NC-DIGITS=1, value 0 — only zero digits are rejected, a zero value is not

cases.name: Interest rate accepts the maximum value 9999.99
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for the key below.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `08`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate `9999.99`; press PF5.
cases.data: Int Rate=9999.99 (4 integer + 2 fraction digits; field is 7 characters)
cases.expected: The maximum rate 9999.99 is accepted and stored; the message line shows `Disclosure group added.`
cases.remark: 6300-PARSE-RATE: 4 int digits + '.' + 2 frac digits = 7 chars = DGRATE length; WS-NEW-RATE S9(04)V99 max 9999.99

cases.name: Interest rate with more than four integer digits is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for the key below.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `07`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate `99999` (5 integer digits); press PF5.
cases.data: Int Rate=99999 (5 integer digits, over the 4-digit limit)
cases.expected: The rate is rejected for exceeding four integer digits; the message line shows `Interest rate is not a valid number.` and no record is written.
cases.remark: 6350-ACCUM-DIGIT: WS-RE-INT-CNT > 4 → invalid → WS-M-RATE-BAD

cases.name: Interest rate with more than two decimal places is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for the key below.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `06`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate `1.999` (3 decimal places); press PF5.
cases.data: Int Rate=1.999 (3 fraction digits, over the 2-digit limit)
cases.expected: The rate is rejected for having more than two decimal places; the message line shows `Interest rate is not a valid number.`
cases.remark: 6350-ACCUM-DIGIT: WS-RE-FRAC-CNT > 2 → invalid → WS-M-RATE-BAD

cases.name: Interest rate zero is accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for the key below.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `05`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate `0`; press PF5.
cases.data: Int Rate=0 → stored 0.00
cases.expected: A zero rate is accepted and stored as 0.00; the message line shows `Disclosure group added.`
cases.remark: 6300-PARSE-RATE: single `0` digit → result 0.00 (only an all-spaces rate is rejected)

cases.name: Interest rate entered as a whole number is stored with two decimals
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for the key below.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `04`, Category `0001`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate `15` (no decimal point); press PF5.
cases.data: Int Rate=15 → stored 15.00
cases.expected: The whole number is accepted and stored as 15.00; the message line shows `Disclosure group added.`
cases.remark: 6300-PARSE-RATE: no dot → fraction 0 → result 15.00

cases.name: Interest rate with two decimal points is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. No group exists for the key below.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account Group `GOLD`, Type Code `02`, Category `0009`; press ENTER (new group).
2. Enter Interest Rate `1.2.3` (two decimal points); press PF5.
cases.data: Int Rate=1.2.3 (two decimal points)
cases.expected: The rate is rejected because it has more than one decimal point; the message line shows `Interest rate is not a valid number.`
cases.remark: 6300-PARSE-RATE: a second `.` with WS-RE-DOT-SW='Y' → invalid → WS-M-RATE-BAD
